999008199.text: 世界の果て、北を目指す航海の準備ができました！

localizations.en: We're ready to set sail north toward World's End!

999008199.text: いやー、時間かかったわね。まずはめでたい

localizations.en: Preparations took a while. But hey, we made it.

999008199.text:
つきましては、具体的な航路についての
作戦会議を始めます！

localizations.en: With that, let's begin our strategy meeting to discuss our exact route!

999008199.text: これが現在分かってる範囲の地図だよ

localizations.en: This is a map of the area that's already charted.

999008199.text:
まずは、北に中継、補給ができる拠点を
作りたいよね

localizations.en: First, we'll want to establish a waypoint up north where we can resupply.

999008199.text:
分かってはいたけど、こんなに島があるのね。
拠点にするならどこがいいのかしら……

localizations.en: I knew there were many islands, but this is more than I expected. I wonder which one would make the best location for a base...

999008199.text: 大きい島のほうが補給はしやすいかも、です……

localizations.en: Bigger islands might be easier to resupply at, maybe...

999008199.text:
そうだね。補給地の候補としては……
ここ！　東メンソス島かな

localizations.en: Right. As for a potential supply point... here! East Mensos Island would be a good choice.

999008199.text: 東？　西もあるの？

localizations.en: East? Does that mean there's a west too?

999008199.text:
元々メンソスは２つの島で１つの国家だったの。
でも、あるとき片方の島が独立しちゃってさ

localizations.en: Mensos was originally one nation made up of two islands. But at some point, one of them declared independence.

999008199.text:
それで東のほうの島を東メンソス、
西のほうの島を西メンソスって呼んでるんだね

localizations.en: So now they call the eastern island East Mensos and the western one West Mensos.

999008199.text:
本当の国名はメンソスなんたらとか長いんだけど
分かりづらいんで、他の島の人はそう区別してる

localizations.en: The official names are way longer—'Kingdom of Mensos' this and that—but everyone just uses East and West Mensos since it's easier.

999008199.text:
そういう複雑な経緯もあって、
どっちも諸島同盟には加入してないんだよね

localizations.en: Because of that messy history, neither of them ended up joining the Archipelago Federation.

999008199.text:
それって、私たちが立ち寄っても大丈夫なのかしら？
ケイウンでも少し入国に手間取ったと聞いているけれど

localizations.en: Is it safe for us to stop there? I heard you had some trouble getting into Keiun too.

999008199.text: それは問題ないと思います

localizations.en: I don't think that'll be a problem.

999008199.text:
諸島同盟内の国との交易もありますし、
治安が悪いっていう話も聞きませんしね

localizations.en: They do trade with nations in the Federation, and I haven't heard of any problems with safety or security.

999008199.text:
その辺りまでなら水や食料も十分持ちそうだ。
中継地点としちゃ、ちょうどいいんじゃねえか？

localizations.en: We should have plenty of water and food to make it that far. Sounds like a solid waypoint to me.

999008199.text:
じゃあ東メンソスに立ち寄って、そこでも
果ての大陸について情報収集して……

localizations.en: Then we'll stop at East Mensos and gather information about World's End there too...

999008199.text:
距離的にはもう１か所くらい中継地を経由して……
最終的にはここ！

localizations.en: Given the distance, we'll probably need to stop at one more waypoint, and then... here!

999008199.text: 地図の一番北の島……「オーベンランド」、ですか

localizations.en: The northernmost island on the map... "Obenland."

999008199.text:
うん。一応、人は住んでるみたいだけど……
交流もないし、どんな場所かはぜんぜん分かんないや

localizations.en: Yeah. People apparently live there, but... we don't have any contact with them, so I have no idea what it's like.

999008199.text: 海の果てを目指すには、そこからさらに北へ……

localizations.en: And to reach the edge of the sea, we'll have to go even farther north from there...

999008199.text:
長旅になるのは分かってたけど、ここまでとはね。
これでパルメ族が邪魔してきたらどうしようかしら

localizations.en: I knew it'd be a long journey, but seeing it planned out is something else. What if the Palme try to interfere again?

999008199.text:
果ての大陸を目指すのは師匠たちの指示通りだし
邪魔はしてこない……と思いたいけど

localizations.en: Heading to World's End is what Miss Saskia and the others told us to do, so I'd like to think that they wouldn't get in our way...

999008199.text:
ケイウンの時みたいに文句を言ってきたら
今度は私が締めてやるんだから！

localizations.en: If they start mouthing off again like they did in Keiun, I'll shut them up myself this time!

999008199.text: は、はうぅ……
こらこら、レイニャちゃんが怖がってるでしょーが
ごめん、ちょっと噴き上がっちゃった！

localizations.en: Sorry, I got a little heated there!

999008199.text: いえ、レイニャのほうこそダメダメでごめんなさい……

localizations.en: N-no, I'm the one who should apologize for being so useless...

999008199.text:
まま、お二人とも気にしなさんな。
楽しくやっていきまっしょい！

localizations.en: Hey, no worries, you two. Let's just have fun out there!

999008199.text:
では当面の目標は東メンソス島ということで……
会議、終了とします！　お疲れさまでした！

localizations.en: All right, so our first goal is East Mensos Island... Meeting adjourned! Great work, everyone!
